title: Forward and Inverse Virtual Metrology for Phototransistor Gain: A Hierarchical, Uncertainty-Aware Approach for Small Production Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2608.11868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The customization, optimization and stabilization of the process flow of a silicon bipolar phototransistor commits months of cleanroom time before a finished device can be measured, so a model that predicts device gain from process parameters before a run has value out of proportion to its accuracy. We study this problem on a real fabrication history, thirteen to fourteen process runs of a single device: a small-sample, hierarchically structured setting unlike the large-corpus regime of conventional virtual metrology. Decomposing the variance of device gain, we find that roughly half of it lies between process runs rather than within them, so recipe-only prediction is bounded by construction. Building on these findings we provide a forward gain predictor with a relative, uncertainty-aware signal, an inverse search that returns recipes for a target gain, and, as the foundation for all of it, a multi-level data-quality assessment tailored

translated_title: 光电晶体管增益的正向与逆向虚拟计量：面向小批量生产数据集的分层、不确定性感知方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11868v1 公告类型：新 摘要：硅双极光电晶体管工艺流的定制、优化和稳定化需要在成品器件可测量之前投入数月洁净室时间，因此，一个能在运行前根据工艺参数预测器件增益的模型，其价值远超其精度本身。我们在一个真实制造历史（单一器件的十三到十四次工艺运行）上研究此问题：这是一个小样本、分层结构化的场景，不同于传统虚拟计量的大语料库模式。通过分解器件增益的方差，我们发现大约一半的方差存在于工艺运行之间而非运行内部，因此仅基于配方的预测在构造上受到限制。基于这些发现，我们提供了一个具有相对、不确定性感知信号的正向增益预测器，一个返回目标增益配方的逆向搜索，以及作为这一切基础的多级数据质量评估，该评估针对此场景量身定制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对小批量生产数据集的分层、不确定性感知虚拟计量方法，通过方差分解发现工艺运行间变异主导增益，并开发了正向预测与逆向配方搜索工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hierarchical, uncertainty-aware virtual metrology approach for small production datasets, revealing that inter-run variance dominates gain and providing forward prediction and inverse recipe search tools.
